justification: Website readers of the flood planning answer (verify app, DA intake, consumer check) and the brief's withdrawn sections. Not Critical: yes answers only widen (the 47 store-only addresses) and the consumer check can no longer pass from a map. Not Minor: served answers and page sections change.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Fails if a store no overturns a state yes, a not-known becomes no, a backend failure changes the state answer, or the brief shows a withdrawn section.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: 310 saved addresses: store finds 47 on a map layer 230 does not (2026-10-28).
falsifiable_check.observed_red: The lookup budget test went red with a bare timer on the new backend call and green with fetchWithTimeout.

pre_impl.existing_data: floodMapStatus feeds verify profile, portal constraints and DA intake; layer 230 publishes ~10 plans.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: canibuildit check passed any point outside a flood row in a council with any flood row.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: One endpoint over the existing producer; one TS combine function.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Backend failure returns null and leaves the state answer unchanged.

functions.name: combineFloodAnswers

functions.output: FloodMapStatus with floodProne and a plain note
functions.if_none: A null store answer leaves the state answer unchanged.
functions.edge_cases: store no worded as a point answer

functions.name: POST /pipeline/flood-planning
